# Stop-ZbxWatch

## SYNOPSIS

Stops a watch.

## SYNTAX

```
Stop-ZbxWatch [-Name] <string> [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Stop-ZbxWatch cmdlet stops the watch named in -Name, or each watch piped from Get-ZbxWatch: it stops reading, ends every Receive-ZbxWatch reading from it, and removes it from the runspace. A watch also stops when the runspace closes. -WhatIf shows which watch it would stop. It writes nothing.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Stop a watch by name

```powershell
Stop-ZbxWatch -Name 'requests'
```

-Name (position 0) is the name Watch-ZbxItem gave the watch.

### Example 2: Stop every watch of the session

```powershell
Get-ZbxWatch | Stop-ZbxWatch
```

Get-ZbxWatch writes each running watch, and its Name binds to -Name.

## PARAMETERS
